page.title: Rest Options Sheet - TachoMobile 2
page.heading: Rest Options Sheet
page.intro: The Rest Options Sheet appears when you are Off Work and your current/main activity is Rest. It lets you view available rest goals and manage how they are used.

when.title: When the sheet opens
when.text: The sheet is available only when you are Off Work. In this situation, tapping the Rest activity does not open the normal Add Activity window. It opens the Rest Options Sheet instead.

contents.title: What the sheet shows
contents.intro: At the top, the sheet shows the current Rest duration and Rest start time. The available rest goals are shown below these values.

header.title: Daily rest goals
header.text: Depending on the current situation, a 9-hour or 11-hour daily rest goal may be available. The main application screen normally counts down to the nearest or next daily rest goal.

daily.title: Daily rest goals
daily.text: Use the selectable dot next to a daily rest goal to choose which available goal is used by the countdown on the main screen. This selection only changes the displayed goal; it does not complete the rest or change its classification.

weekly.title: Weekly rest goals
weekly.text: Weekly rest goals are shown below the daily goals: 24 hours and 45 hours. Each goal shows how much time remains, its deadline, and the day and time when the goal will be reached or expires.

countdown.title: 1. Choose the goal for the main-screen countdown
countdown.text: Tap the selectable dot next to a rest goal to make it the goal used by the rest countdown/timer on the main application screen. By default, the main screen shows the nearest daily rest goal, but you can change it to another available goal. This does not mark the rest as completed and does not change its classification.

weekly.title: 2. Select a weekly rest
weekly.text: Weekly rest goals have a Select action. Selecting one marks that rest as the intended weekly rest. If the resulting rest reaches the required duration, for example 24 hours for the 24-hour goal, it is counted directly as weekly rest instead of remaining only a candidate waiting for the end of the 144-hour window. See Related Content for more about weekly rest candidates.

alarm.title: 3. Set an alarm
alarm.text: An alarm-clock icon appears next to each rest deadline. Tap it to open the system alarm/clock application and set an alarm for the time when the selected rest goal will be completed or reach its deadline. TachoMobile opens the system alarm functionality; it does not create a custom in-app alarm.

manual.title: Manual entries outside working time
manual.text: Manual entries outside working time are handled in Journal. Open Options, select Shift finished, and add a new shift or sequence there. This process belongs to the Activity Entry article.
